properties.title: User Approval Required Before Signing
properties.description: The wallet must obtain explicit user approval before signing any message via wallet_signIntendedValidatorData
properties.formal_spec: FORALL sign_request IN validator_sign_requests: user_approval(sign_request) == true BEFORE sign_hash(sign_request)

properties.title: Correct EIP-191 Message Format
properties.description: The signed message must be formatted as 0x19 || 0x00 || validatorAddress || dataToSign
properties.formal_spec: FORALL sig IN validator_signatures: signed_message(sig) == concat(0x19, 0x00, sig.validator_address, sig.data)

properties.title: Hash Computed Before Signing
properties.description: The keccak256 hash of the prefixed message must be computed before ECDSA signing
properties.formal_spec: FORALL sig IN validator_signatures: hash_message(sig.prefixed_message) EXECUTES BEFORE ecdsa_sign(sig.hash)

properties.title: Validator Uses Own Address for Verification
properties.description: When verifying a signature, the validator must use its own address in the message reconstruction
properties.formal_spec: FORALL verification IN signature_verifications: verification.reconstructed_message.validator_address == verification.validator.own_address

properties.title: Address Comparison Determines Validity
properties.description: Signature is valid if and only if the recovered address matches the claimed signer
properties.formal_spec: FORALL verification IN signature_verifications: verification.valid == (ecrecover(verification.hash, verification.sig) == verification.claimed_signer)

properties.title: Cross-Validator Signature Reuse Blocked
properties.description: A signature created for one validator cannot be successfully verified by a different validator
properties.formal_spec: FORALL sig IN validator_signatures, v IN validators WHERE v.address != sig.intended_validator: verify(v, sig) == false

properties.title: Transaction Replay Blocked by Prefix
properties.description: Signatures created via wallet_signIntendedValidatorData cannot be submitted as Ethereum transactions
properties.formal_spec: FORALL sig IN validator_signatures: is_valid_transaction(sig.raw_signature) == false

properties.title: 65-Byte Signature Returned
properties.description: A successful signing operation must return a 65-byte ECDSA signature (r, s, v)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL sig IN successful_sign_requests: len(sig.result) == 65

properties.title: Index Set to Zero in Signed Data
properties.description: When signing attestation data, the index field must be set to zero (committee info excluded from signature)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation IN electra_attestations: attestation.signed_data.index == 0

properties.title: Cross-Committee Aggregation Enabled
properties.description: Attestations with identical (beacon_block_root, source, target) can be aggregated across different committees
properties.formal_spec: FORALL a1, a2 IN attestations WHERE a1.root == a2.root AND a1.source == a2.source AND a1.target == a2.target: can_aggregate(a1, a2) == true

properties.title: Aggregated Signature Verified with Fewer Pairings
properties.description: Verification of aggregated attestations requires O(1) pairings instead of O(n) per committee
properties.formal_spec: FORALL aggregate IN verified_aggregates: verification_pairings(aggregate) <= aggregate.committee_count

properties.title: Pre-Electra Attestations Rejected Post-Fork
properties.description: Attestations using the old format (committee index in signed data) cannot be included after Electra activation
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation IN post_electra_blocks: attestation.format == ELECTRA_FORMAT

properties.title: Offline Penalty for Rejected Attestations
properties.description: Validators whose attestations are rejected at fork boundary incur one-epoch offline penalty
properties.formal_spec: FORALL validator IN validators WHERE fork_boundary_rejection(validator): validator.penalty == ONE_EPOCH_OFFLINE_PENALTY

properties.title: Committee Membership Verified Before Caching
properties.description: Before caching an attestation, the attester's membership in the claimed committee must be verified
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation IN cached_attestations: verify_committee_membership(attestation.attester, attestation.committee_bits) == true

properties.title: Invalid Membership Causes Rejection
properties.description: Attestations with invalid committee membership claims must be rejected
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation IN gossip_attestations: NOT verify_committee_membership(attestation) IMPLIES attestation.rejected == true

properties.title: MAX_ATTESTER_SLASHINGS Limited to 1
properties.description: At most 1 attester slashing can be included per block to bound worst-case block size
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block IN electra_blocks: count(block.attester_slashings) <= 1

properties.title: Block Size Within Acceptable Bounds
properties.description: After applying limits, block size must remain within acceptable bounds
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block IN electra_blocks: block.total_size <= MAX_ACCEPTABLE_BLOCK_SIZE

properties.title: Validation Before User Prompt
properties.description: All parameter validations must pass before prompting the user for consent
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request IN chain_add_requests: all_validations_passed(request) BEFORE show_user_confirmation(request)

properties.title: User Consent Required for Chain Addition
properties.description: No chain can be added to the wallet without explicit user approval
properties.formal_spec: FORALL chain IN added_chains: user_approved(chain) == true

properties.title: Chain ID Mismatch Fails Validation
properties.description: If RPC-reported chain ID does not match submitted chain ID, the request must fail
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request IN chain_add_requests: rpc_chain_id(request.rpc) != request.chain_id IMPLIES request.result == REJECTED

properties.title: HTTPS Required for RPC URLs
properties.description: All RPC URLs must use HTTPS scheme; HTTP and file schemes must be rejected
properties.formal_spec: FORALL url IN request.rpc_urls: url.scheme == 'https'

properties.title: RPC URLs Array Must Be Non-Empty
properties.description: The rpcUrls array must contain at least one valid URL
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request IN valid_chain_requests: len(request.rpc_urls) >= 1

properties.title: All Validations Must Pass
properties.description: Chain is added only if all validation steps pass: hex format, URLs, scheme, no duplicate, chain ID match, currency
properties.formal_spec: FORALL chain IN added_chains: valid_hex(chain.id) AND valid_urls(chain) AND valid_scheme(chain) AND no_duplicate(chain) AND chain_id_matches(chain) AND valid_currency(chain)

properties.title: Submitted Chain ID Used for Signing
properties.description: For transaction signing, the wallet must use the submitted chainId, never the RPC-reported ID
properties.formal_spec: FORALL tx IN signed_transactions: tx.chain_id == chain.submitted_chain_id

properties.title: User Warned About RPC Exposure
properties.description: User must be warned that activity and IP will be exposed to RPC endpoints
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request IN chain_add_requests WHERE user_prompted(request): rpc_exposure_warning_shown(request) == true

properties.title: Requester Identity Displayed
properties.description: The identity/origin of the requesting dApp must be displayed to the user
properties.formal_spec: FORALL confirmation IN user_confirmations: confirmation.requester_origin_displayed == true

properties.title: Validation Failure Returns Error
properties.description: Any validation failure must result in an error response to the dApp
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request IN chain_add_requests: validation_failed(request) IMPLIES error_returned(request)

properties.title: Validator Address Displayed to User
properties.description: The wallet must display the validator address to the user for verification before signing
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request IN sign_requests WHERE confirmation_shown(request): request.validator_address_displayed == true

properties.title: Chain ID Hex Format Required
properties.description: The chainId must be a valid 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request IN chain_add_requests: is_valid_hex(request.chain_id) == true

properties.title: Committee Info in Outer Container Only
properties.description: Committee index information must be in the outer attestation container, not the signed data
properties.formal_spec: FORALL attestation IN electra_attestations: attestation.committee_bits != null AND attestation.signed_data.index == 0
